host_ms.what:
host_ms.py OUT.json: host ms of the recognizer (ms per line, vocr_cli --repeat) and the spotter (ms per region,
vocr_textspot6_test --bench) for the base and the new runtime, gcc at -O2 (the runtime's flags) and at -O3 -march=native,
one thread, on the development lines (sub24, 24 lines of 60-100 frames) and 60 development regions as Rubi's crop decode
reads them. Each figure is the median over --runs runs (the box is shared: other jobs run beside these).
